name: Thierry Dubois
bio:
Thierry's journey into motorsport began, predictably, with a childhood fascination for go-karts and Formula 1, fueled by watching Michael Schumacher dominate the tracks. He quickly realized he enjoyed understanding how things worked far more than driving them. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, specializing in precision manufacturing, and landed his first role at a small parts manufacturer supplying components to various racing teams. 

He joined Kosmic Kart five years ago, bringing a meticulous eye for detail and a relentless pursuit of perfection. Thierry sees his role in quality control as a vital component of a team's success. He is known for his ability to identify even the most minute flaws, which often makes the difference between a podium finish and a DNF. He considers himself a 'lone wolf' and prefers to work independently. 

Thierry's distinctiveness lies in his commitment to continuous improvement. He's not just looking for defects; he's always seeking ways to enhance the manufacturing process and improve the overall quality of components. His colleagues are sometimes frustrated by his high standards, but they acknowledge the value he brings to the team.

physical.description: Thierry is of average height and build with a focused demeanor.

quirks: Always sharpens his pencils to a perfect point before starting work.
Carries a small magnifying glass to inspect components.
Has a habit of tapping his pen when thinking deeply.
